description: Declared browser floor and the features that bind it. The charter's frozen browser-floor row is the authority; this manifest is the machine-checked copy, and harness/tests/browser-floor.test.js verifies the two agree, that every listed feature form is present as a substring in published source, and that no present form requires a version above a declared floor. The scan is substring presence checking: argument-form assumptions are declarations reviewed by the operator, not something the check verifies.

sources: charter frozen decisions, browser floor row
charter frozen decisions, browser floor row

features.argumentForms: same-type percentage arguments only; the meter quantization expressions multiply a unitless count by a percentage and round against a 100% interval. This is a manually reviewed assumption recorded here, not something the source scan verifies: the scan reports substring presence of round( and scores it against this same-type requirement. Mixed length/percentage arguments would require Safari 17.2, above the declared 16.4 floor, and are a stop condition for the operator, not a floor the harness may raise on its own.
sources: WebKit features in Safari 17.2, math functions note (webkit.org/blog/14787)
